description: This file defines the BrowserHandler class for managing browser-related operations in Firefox, including enabling/disabling features, managing browser contexts, handling targets, and setting preferences. It interacts with Mozilla-specific services and modules.

classes.name: BrowserHandler
classes.description: A class managing browser operations, target handling, context management, and preferences in Firefox.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the BrowserHandler with session, dispatcher, target registry, start promise, and onclose callback.

methods.name: Browser.enable
methods.description: Enables the browser domain, sets preferences, and attaches event listeners.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Removes event listeners and cleans up sessions and contexts.

methods.name: _shouldAttachToTarget
methods.description: Determines if a target should be attached based on context.

methods.name: _onTargetCreated
methods.description: Handles target creation, attaches sessions, and sets up page handlers.

methods.name: _onTargetDestroyed
methods.description: Handles target destruction and session cleanup.

methods.name: _onDownloadCreated
methods.description: Emits event when a download is created.

methods.name: _onDownloadFinished
methods.description: Emits event when a download finishes.

methods.name: Browser.newPage
methods.description: Creates a new page in a specified browser context.

methods.name: Browser.close
methods.description: Closes the browser window and quits the application.

methods.name: Browser.grantPermissions
methods.description: Grants permissions for a specific origin.

methods.name: Browser.resetPermissions
methods.description: Resets permissions for a browser context.

methods.name: Browser.setExtraHTTPHeaders
methods.description: Sets extra HTTP headers for a browser context.

methods.name: Browser.setHTTPCredentials
methods.description: Sets HTTP credentials for a browser context.

methods.name: Browser.setContextProxy
methods.description: Sets proxy settings for a specific browser context.

methods.name: Browser.setCacheDisabled
methods.description: Disables or enables cache for a context.

methods.name: Browser.setDownloadOptions
methods.description: Sets download options for a context.

methods.name: Browser.addBinding
methods.description: Adds a binding to a browser context.

methods.name: Browser.getInfo
methods.description: Retrieves browser version and user agent.
